svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 10/12 Big Valley Sky (Common)
svg.desc: Nothing out here to stop it. The sky runs all the way down to the fields. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
